# ORACLE BRIEF

Bitcoin just liquidated every short on the board at $73,000 while Bloomberg was still screaming $10,000. That gap between narrative and price action is not noise—it's signal.

Here's what's actually happening: The Senate voted 89-10 to kill the government's own digital currency. That's supermajority rejection of state money happening in real time.
